_meta.description: A free, open-source Bible app for iPhone, iPad and Mac. Read offline in the ASV, BSB or KJV, highlight and take notes, and sync privately through your own iCloud — no ads, no trackers, no accounts.
_title: Scripture Alone - A Free, Private Bible
a-free-open-source.6fc212: A free, open-source Bible for iPhone, iPad and Mac. Three complete translations live on your device, so you can read, search, highlight and take notes anywhere in the world — with or without a connection.
auto-scroll-keeps-the.e753e5: Auto-scroll keeps the text moving at your pace and carries on into the next chapter — an accessibility feature for anyone who finds scrolling by hand difficult, or simply wants to read without touching the screen.
being-built-now-and.f37881: Being built now, and not in the app yet. They'll ship when they're ready.
blaine-miller-all-rights.b327c2: © Blaine Miller. All rights reserved.
coming-soon-to-the.557a3b: Coming soon to the App Store
cross-references-maps-and.184f76: Cross-references, maps and timelines of the biblical periods, charts, and classic Reformed commentary — a toggle away when you want to dig deeper, out of sight when you just want to read.
every-line-of-code.0797fb: Every line of code is public under the AGPL-3.0 license. Read it, check it, or build it yourself.
everything-here-works-today.40d987: Everything here works today, on the device in your hand.
free-forever-no-ads.ca5514: Free forever. No ads, no trackers, no accounts. Built to help people study God's word and grow closer to Christ.
hear-any-chapter-read.b40fe9: Hear any chapter read aloud with the system voices, or hand it off to Mi Speaks for its Studio voices.
highlight-in-five-colors.eb0a84: Highlight in five colors. Attach a note to one or more passages — a Sunday sermon on Romans 8:1–17, say — and see it inline beside the verse and gathered in the Notes panel.
is-scripture-alone-available.8b64bc: Is Scripture Alone available in the European Union?
it-s-a-careful.2cd1ba: It's a careful, word-for-word translation in the public domain, so it can be given away freely — the Berean Standard Bible and King James Version are included for the same reason. Translations like the CSB, ESV, NKJV and NASB need publisher licenses, which we're requesting.
make-a-beautiful-image.4df149: Make a beautiful image of a verse right on your device. Share links rebuild the image in the browser from the link itself — nothing is stored on a server.
no-ads-no-analytics.490c17: No ads. No analytics. No third-party SDKs. Your notes travel only through your own iCloud.
none-there-are-no.762c80: None. There are no analytics, no trackers and no accounts. Your highlights and notes stay on your devices and sync only through your own private iCloud, which I can't see.
nothing-between-you-and.27b4f3: Nothing between you and the text
psalm-23-in-the.1e0f7e: Psalm 23 in the American Standard Version on the Sepia theme, and the reading options behind the Aa button.
set-the-way-it.444ce2: Set the way it was written
seven-typefaces-adjustable-size.3f53bc: Seven typefaces, adjustable size and line spacing, and five themes — Auto, Light, Sepia, Dark and Black. Read in paragraphs or verse by verse, with full Dynamic Type support.
share-a-read-only.8c0ea6: Share a read-only copy of your notes and highlights with your family, or export them as a keepsake — a digital “Dad's Bible” to hand down.
snap-the-sermon-slide.cf0596: Snap the sermon slide at church. On-device text recognition titles your note and links the passages it mentions.
the-american-standard-version.b8d7a4: The American Standard Version, the Berean Standard Bible and the King James Version — all public domain, all stored on your device, with full-text search. No signal needed, anywhere in the world.
the-word-and-nothing.59b9cc: The Word, and nothing in the way.
the-words-of-christ.c6c665: The words of Christ in red, section headings, poetry laid out as poetry, and footnotes a tap away.
type-jn-3-16.ee05d2: Type “jn 3 16” or “rom 8:28-39” to jump to a passage, or search for any word or phrase.
we-re-requesting-licenses.06f2fd: We're requesting licenses from the publishers of the CSB, ESV, NKJV and NASB. Each will be added only if its license is granted.
yes-no-ads-no.bf78fd: Yes. No ads, no in-app purchases, no subscriptions. Scripture Alone is free, and it will stay free.
yes-the-full-source.c48195: Yes. The full source is on GitHub under the AGPL-3.0 license.
yes-when-scripture-alone.86db06: Yes. When Scripture Alone arrives on the App Store, it will be available everywhere in the European Union, France included. The source code is open to everyone on GitHub today.
your-highlights-and-notes.9e0f41: Your highlights and notes follow you across iPhone, iPad and Mac through your own private iCloud. No account, no server — I never see your data.
